camel_example: aliyun r-kvstore DescribeParameterTemplates --region cn-hangzhou --EngineVersion '5.0' --CharacterType logic --Engine Redis
description_en: Queries the parameters and default values of ApsaraDB Tair (Redis® OSS-Compatible) database instances across different architectures and major engine versions
description_zh: 查询云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）实例在不同架构和大版本下的参数列表和默认值
kebab_example: aliyun r-kvstore describe-parameter-templates --character-type logic --engine Redis --engine-version 5.0 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeParameterTemplates

parameters.help_en:
The architecture of the instance. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86132.html. Valid values:
logic: cluster or read/write splitting architecture
normal: standard architecture (primary/secondary)

<props="china">When EngineVersion is set to 6.0, this parameter does not support the logic value.</props>
parameters.help_zh:
实例的架构，更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86132.html。取值：
logic：集群或读写分离架构。
normal：标准架构（主备）。

<props="china">当EngineVersion取值为6.0时，本参数不支持传入logic。</props>
parameters.name: character_type

parameters.help_en: The database engine. Set the value to Redis
parameters.help_zh: 数据库类型，取值固定为Redis
parameters.name: engine

parameters.help_en: The major engine version of the instance. Valid values: 4.0, 5.0, 6.0, and 7.0
parameters.name: engine_version

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource group. You can invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/158855.html operation to query the ID of the resource group.
You can also obtain the resource group ID in the console. For related operations, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/151181.html
parameters.help_zh:
资源组ID。您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/158855.html接口获取资源组ID。
您也可以通过控制台获取资源组ID，相关操作，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/151181.html
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473778.html operation to query the instance ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to query the account parameter template. Set the value to account
parameters.help_zh: 是否查询账号参数模板，固定值 account
parameters.name: parameter_category

Engine.description_en: The database engine. The value is always Redis
Engine.description_zh: 数据库类型，返回值固定为Redis

EngineVersion.description_en: The major engine version of the instance

TemplateRecord.description_en: The list of detailed parameter information

CheckingCode.description_en: The valid values of the parameter

ForceModify.description_en:
Indicates whether the parameter can be modified. Valid values:
true: The parameter can be modified.
false: The parameter cannot be modified
ForceModify.description_zh:
参数是否可修改，返回值：
true：可修改。
false：不可修改

ForceRestart.description_en:
Indicates whether a restart is required for the parameter modification to take effect. Valid values:
true: A restart is required for the modification to take effect.
false: The modification takes effect immediately without a restart
ForceRestart.description_zh:
参数修改后，是否需要重启生效，返回值：
true：需要重启生效。
false：修改后立即生效，无需重启

ParameterName.description_en: The name of the parameter. For more information about the purpose and settings of the parameter, see [metric description]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/259681.html）
ParameterName.description_zh: 参数名，更多关于参数作用的介绍和设置说明，请参见[参数说明]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/259681.html）

ParameterValue.description_en: The default value of the parameter
